name: Realtor 信件 → 自動更新網站房源

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5', max_tokens: 800, system: "You turn a realtor's email into website listing actions.
Allowed actions: hide, show, hero_on, hero_off, feature, unfeature, mark_sold, not_sold, set_sold_price.
- hide: don't show a listing on the website. show: show it again.
- hero_on / hero_off: add/remove a listing in the homepage slider (max 3).
- feature / unfeature: featured listing on/off.
- mark_sold: move to Sold. not_sold: it did not sell / remove it from Sold.
- set_sold_price: value = the sold price as a number.
Match listings ONLY from the provided list (by address, unit, street, MLS number). Use the listing "id".
Reply with JSON only, no prose:
{"actions":[{"action":"...","listing_id":"...","value":null}],"needs_human":false,"reason":""}
If the email asks for anything else (text/design changes, new listings, questions), or you are not sure which listing is meant, return {"actions":[],"needs_human":true,"reason":"<short reason>"}.
If the email is not a request at all (thanks, chit-chat), return {"actions":[],"needs_human":false,"reason":"no request"}.", messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Listings:
' + JSON.stringify($json.listings) + '

Email subject: ' + $('New email (sony@bluluma.com)').item.json.subject + '

Email body:
' + ($('New email (sony@bluluma.com)').item.json.textPlain || '').slice(0, 6000) }] }) }}

={{ $json.skip ? JSON.stringify({ op: 'noop' }) : JSON.stringify({ op: 'apply', sender: $json.sender, subject: $json.subject, action: $json.action, listing_id: $json.listing_id, value: $json.value }) }}

parameters.subject: ={{ '【需要 Sony 處理】' + $json.subject }}
parameters.text:
={{ '寄件人: ' + $json.sender + '

原因:
' + $json.problem + ($json.done ? '

已自動完成:
' + $json.done : '') + '

--- 原信 ---
' + $json.body }}
